programs.desc: Andrew Zimmern begins another culinary adventure, during which he will again taste the strangest dishes in the world, from wild goat to duck liver.In the new season of the show, Andrew will taste snake eggs in Japan and drink snake bile in Shanghai.In Okinawa, people eat pickled pig's ear, poisonous urchin fish and tuna eye.Finally, he will go to China to try turtle, chicken hearts and snail shells.Viewers will find out whether Andrew will survive such a difficult test.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc:
Marcin Prokop will go on a spontaneous journey around America in a program full of humor.During his journey across the United States, which lasts over a month, the journalist will cover thousands of kilometers.Viewers will have the opportunity to see the alleys of the largest Chinese district in the US, find themselves behind the walls of the most famous prison, Alcatraz, and look out the window of the tallest skyscraper in San Francisco.The host will stop at the world's largest stop for giant trucks, visit a hippie town and visit a unique restaurant connected to a laundry.The audience will be able to feast their eyes on amazing landscapes, unique national parks and wonderful waterfalls
In this episode, Marcin will go to San Francisco.The presenter will cross the Golden Gate Bridge, where Agent 007 fought a murderous fight with Max Zorin in the film about the adventures of James Bond.He will also visit the colorful Castro district, where Harvey Milk once fought for homosexual rights.Then he will go to the Haight-Ashbury district, the cradle of hippies, where Marcin will undergo a surprising metamorphosis.A visit to this city would not be complete without a trip to Lombard Street, known as the most twisted street in the world.After a walk through the city streets, the presenter will take us to the most liberal beach in California and show us the famous Alcatraz prison, where Al Capone ended his gangster career.

Marcin Prokop leaves bustling San Francisco and sets off on a further journey.This time, the host visited the city of South Lake Tahoe, located on the border of two states - California and Nevada.Instead of a concrete jungle, viewers will be able to admire mountain landscapes, waterfalls and sandy beaches stretching along Lake Tahoe.Next, Marcin will stop in a deserted ghost town.The host will also visit the "potato state" of Idaho, where he will turn from a two-meter tall fairy into a real cowboy.Viewers will have the opportunity to learn how the presenter will perform as a Western hero and how much the largest potato in the world weighs.
